input_formation.decoder: PyAV frame decode in stream order; PTS*time_base half-open selection; no resampling

input_formation.stored_per_frame_data: only post-letterbox RGB24 canvas, zlib content-addressed object
input_formation.window_policy: all decoded frames with exact PTS timestamp in [start,end); preserve native PTS gaps
input_formation.yuv420: frozen fixed_codec.rgb_to_planes; int16 planes cast to u8 and concatenated only for hash

media_provenance.qualification_claim: New PTS windows within existing media only; no new game, capture, or project-wide unseen-data claim.

scope: Source preparation only: no codec, candidate generation, native comparison, or quality selection.
No PTS resampling, interpolation, frame duplication, or deduplication; actual decoded frames are archived.
External original files are checked against the separately declared media hashes before and after decode.
The 1600 and combat source origin is not in the reviewed shared source manifest and needs explicit provenance in downstream claims.
All windows are portions of precompressed footage from a single Mass Effect source lineage; this is not new game/capture or project-wide unseen content.
